purpose: Test whether clarification-enabled Deep Research harnesses recover high-impact preferences and improve fixed-rubric personalization on the first three reselected PDR tasks.

hypotheses.statement: Clarification-supported harness conditions have higher mean P_rubric than clarification-disabled or not-usually-supported conditions.
hypotheses.primary_controlled_contrast: same backbone and harness with clarification enabled versus disabled
hypotheses.ecological_contrast: DeerFlow 2.0 and Open Deep Research versus DeerFlow 1.x, OAgents, and commercial Deep Research products

hypotheses.statement: Coverage@HighImpact is positively associated with final P_rubric.
hypotheses.caveat: Question count alone is not predicted to be monotonic; coverage and precision are the mechanism variables.

hypotheses.statement: For the preregistered Task 3 case, cold-start clarification-enabled P_rubric exceeds full-persona clarification-disabled P_rubric under the same backbone, tools, budget, and report contract.

primary_metric.name: P_rubric
primary_metric.definition: Sum of five fixed task-specific rubric scores, each scored 0=ignored/contradicted, 1=partial/non-consequential, 2=clear consequential implementation.

process_metrics.coverage_at_high_impact: Number of five high-impact preferences recoverable from the answered clarification conversation divided by five.
process_metrics.clarification_turns: Assistant turns containing one or more clarification questions before research.
process_metrics.atomic_questions: Semantically independent requested fields or trade-offs, regardless of punctuation.
process_metrics.question_precision: Atomic questions that target a high-impact preference divided by all atomic questions.
process_metrics.grounded_p: Rubric credit retained only where the corresponding high-impact preference was recovered in clarification.

full_matrix_target.missing_cell_policy: Record unsupported or uncredentialed cells explicitly; never silently substitute another model.

interaction_budget.native_behavior_rule: The exact workbook instruction is the first visible user message. Clarification support is supplied only by the frozen harness condition.

required: tool, query, fetch, failure, and timestamp trace

judging.adjudication: A two-point disagreement on any 0/1/2 rubric item requires an additional adjudication pass.
judging.official_pdr_p: secondary only and never merged with P_rubric

claim_boundary: Three tasks are a falsification-oriented pilot. Repeated generations diagnose within-cell variability but do not turn three tasks into a population sample.
